data.explanation: Your tennis club (TSV Beispielstadt) could not collect the 2027 annual membership fee by direct debit because the payment bounced, so it added a €3.00 fee for bank charges. You now owe €183.00 in total. Transfer this amount to the club's account by the deadline shown in this reminder. According to the letter, if the money has not arrived by then, your playing rights (Spielrecht) will be suspended under the club's fee rules (Beitragsordnung) until you pay. If you think the failed direct debit was a mistake (e.g. your bank details changed), it may help to contact the club's treasurer (Kassenwartin) directly.
